newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine telecom firms make bid for rate changes.
newsitem.headline: Argentine telecom firms make bid for rate changes.

text.p: Argentina's telecommunications firms Telecom Argentina and Telefonica de Argentina presented legal bids Monday to annul rulings suspending recent changes to the country's telephone rates, private news agency DYN reported.

Since President Carlos Menem's government decreed changes in telephone rates at the end of last month, raising local call costs and cutting long distance ones, a series of judges have ruled the changes be suspended until the courts decide on their legality.
Those rulings were made after consumer groups and opposition politicians challenged them in the courts.

But Telecom Argentina presented a case to the courts Monday basing its claim on the ruling of a judge from the province of Cordoba who said the new rate changes are valid. The government has maintained the rate changes remain in force on the back of this ruling.
Separately on Monday, a lawyer told Reuters he has presented a charge against officials in the government for having "disobeyed" the rulings suspending the rate changes.
